message: One production nonuniform physical-rho combined Maxwell/CUDA-thermal AD-FD smoke passed in the adjoint-aligned direction at h=0.005 with 0.538674% relative error. Forward/adjoint auto-nonuniform mesh parity was restored by retaining the forward Gaussian source enabled at exactly zero amplitude during the adjoint; the maximum source-to-mesh mismatch is 6.776e-21 m and no coordinate exceeds the 2e-18 m tolerance. No empirical normalization, gradient rescaling, CPU FDTD fallback, or optimization iteration was used. Broader directional evidence, gray-law sensitivity, full latent/filter/projection AD-FD, and design-window selection still block optimization.
